The Date object can silently corrupt dates where days are 12 or less by interpreting them as months.

Automated document extraction should rely on deterministic parsing for data extraction and arithmetic validation for proof, rather than relying solely on vision models to interpret raw numbers. Extraction has been proven on a real 86-row card statement, but no real balance-column statement has been reconciled yet.
